CustomField.formula: IF ( ISPICKVAL( DeliveryLocationType__c, 'Delivery Center' ), DeliveryCenter__r.ShippingStreet & " " & DeliveryCenter__r.ShippingCity & ' ' & DeliveryCenter__r.ShippingState & IF ( NOT(ISBLANK( DeliveryCenter__r.ShippingPostalCode )), ', ' & DeliveryCenter__r.ShippingPostalCode, '' ) & " " & DeliveryCenter__r.ShippingCountry, DeliveryAddress__Street__s & " " & DeliveryAddress__City__s & ' ' & TEXT(DeliveryAddress__StateCode__s) & IF ( NOT(ISBLANK( DeliveryAddress__PostalCode__s )), ', ' & DeliveryAddress__PostalCode__s, '' ) & " " & TEXT(DeliveryAddress__CountryCode__s) )
CustomField.label: Delivery Address HTML
